factors.source_name: US EPA eGRID2023 metric workbook, revision 2
factors.geography: SERC NERC region; proxy for AWS us-east-1
factors.notes: 365.1339384 kg CO2e/MWh divided by 1000. Annual generation-output proxy, not AWS-reported emissions. Requires attributable facility kWh including cooling overhead and an energy_source reference; no additional PUE. Excludes embodied emissions, upstream fuel emissions and grid losses. AWS-to-SERC mapping: https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/methodology/. Historical direct-energy entry remains restricted to 2023.

factors.source_name: Cloud Carbon Footprint Appendix V / EPA eGRID2023 derived factor
factors.geography: SERC annual regional proxy for AWS Northern Virginia
factors.notes: CCF Appendix V publishes 0.000365127796 metric tons/kWh; multiply by 1000 for kg. Historical annual proxy applied through model year 2026, not verified 2026 grid conditions. Model application window is not a scientific validity guarantee. Different from the retained primary EPA direct-energy reference; do not silently substitute.

factors.source_name: Cloud Carbon Footprint Appendix V Azure East US
factors.geography: Virginia / SERC; normalized eastus alias for CCF East US
factors.notes: Published CCF Azure East US factor 0.000379069 metric tons/kWh converted to kg. Underlying source vintage is unspecified in this table; data_year is deliberately absent. Historical geographic proxy only; not verified 2026 Azure grid data. Dates are the model application window.

factors.source_name: Google Cloud 2025 regional grid carbon intensity
factors.notes: 432 gCO2eq/kWh divided by 1000. Gross operational grid intensity, no CFE discount. Latest-available 2025 proxy used for 2026 scenarios; application dates do not certify 2026 grid conditions.

factors.source_name: Google Cloud 2025 regional grid carbon intensity
factors.notes: 598 gCO2eq/kWh divided by 1000. No CFE discount. Latest-available historical proxy for 2026 model scenarios, not measured 2026 emissions. Not transferable to AWS or Azure India regions.

factors.source_name: Google Cloud 2025 regional grid carbon intensity
factors.notes: 473 gCO2eq/kWh divided by 1000. No CFE discount. Latest-available historical proxy for 2026 model scenarios, not measured 2026 emissions. Not transferable to AWS or Azure India regions.

usage_profiles.geography: CCF generic AWS fleet model; not workload measurement
usage_profiles.notes: Compute/Storage/PUE sections and Appendix I. CCF AWS PUE is itself a published assumption, not current measured fleet PUE. Model application window only.

usage_profiles.geography: CCF generic Azure fleet model; not workload measurement
usage_profiles.notes: Uses the explicitly stated 1.185 in CCF Power Usage Effectiveness section; Appendix I instead lists 1.125. This documented source conflict is unresolved and affects accuracy. Not a current measured Azure fleet PUE. Model application window only.

usage_profiles.geography: CCF generic GCP fleet model; not workload measurement
usage_profiles.notes: Compute/Storage/PUE sections and Appendix I. Generic CCF coefficients, not a contemporary per-site efficiency measurement. Model application window only.
